option_relations.rationale: Ectopic Atrial Tachycardia does not match the clinical presentation and ECG findings
Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) matches the ECG description of irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
Atrial Tachycardia with variable block could be a subtype of Intra-atrial Reentrant Tachycardia, but the ECG findings are more specific for IART
Atrial Flutter with variable conduction does not match the ECG description of irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
